profile.name: USB 原始通信组件
profile.description: 这是一个非物理的软件通信组件，用于封装 pyusb 连接对象，为实验系统提供与 USB 连接设备之间的原始字节读写、超时、终止符和输入缓冲区管理功能。它主要用于底层通信，不对应某一特定硬件仪器。
profile.description_en: This is a non-physical software communication component that wraps a pyusb connection object. It provides raw byte read/write access, timeout handling, terminator configuration, and input buffer management for USB-connected devices in laboratory systems. It is a low-level communication helper rather than a specific hardware instrument.

registry.name: Open Standard USB Communicator
registry.description: Usb Communicator驱动，支持address/close/flush input/read raw/seek等9个操作。
